items.title: 8hjkkwikl8/ai-portfolio
items.summary: 三个可运行的 AI 工程项目：可追溯 RAG、提示词评测与受守护的 NL2SQL 分析
items.summary_zh: 开源项目包含可追溯 RAG、提示词评测与受守护的 NL2SQL 三个工程化模块，提供 Agent 开发的参考实现。
items.why_zh: 掌握 RAG 溯源与 NL2SQL 安全防护的工程落地，学习如何构建可评估的 Agent 提示词工程流水线。

items.title: Experience-Handoff Reinforcement Learning for Recursive Self-Improvement
items.summary: It is common to train Large Language Models (LLMs) for agentic tasks with Reinforcement Learning (RL) from scalar rewards. However, this throws away the fine-grained information about the environment that the agent experienced during the trial (e.g., error logs). To utilize this rich information, recent works wrap the agent in a harness that refines its own inputs through reflection or compaction and hands past experience to future rollouts, but the construction of the handed-off artifacts (e.g.
items.summary_zh: 提出 Experience-Handoff RL 框架，通过将环境交互中的细粒度日志信息转化为反射或压缩后的输入，提升 LLM 自我改进能力。
items.why_zh: 强化学习与 Agent 反思机制结合，学习如何利用环境反馈日志优化 Agent 的上下文输入，提升复杂任务的鲁棒性。

items.title: DeepStress: Stress-Testing Deep Search Agents
items.summary: While search agents demonstrate impressive capabilities in multi-step question answering, their robustness to poor-quality evidence remains under-explored. Such evidence is rare in benchmark corpora, and resulting failures are hard to reproduce. We propose DeepStress, a dynamic stress-testing framework that subjects agents to degraded evidence at controlled rates. It replaces the retrieval module with a synthetic environment where documents are generated dynamically for each query, under indepen
items.summary_zh: DeepStress 框架通过动态注入受损证据，对搜索类 Agent 进行压力测试，评估其在低质量检索环境下的鲁棒性。
items.why_zh: Agent 系统评估与鲁棒性测试，学习通过替换检索模块进行对抗性测试，以识别 Agent 在复杂搜索任务中的潜在失效点。

items.title: Elevated errors on claude.ai, Claude Code, and platform.claude.com
items.summary_zh: Claude 相关平台出现高频错误，涉及网页端、Claude Code 及 API 服务。
items.why_zh: 分布式系统稳定性与 API 容错设计，学习在依赖第三方模型服务时，如何通过降级策略与重试机制保障 Agent 业务连续性。

items.title: United Airlines bans AI agents from booking flights on behalf of travelers
items.summary_zh: 美联航 United Airlines 正式禁止 AI Agent 代表旅客进行机票预订操作，以应对自动化爬虫带来的系统负载与合规风险。
items.why_zh: Agent 落地场景的边界控制。可探讨 Agent 在高并发业务场景下的 API 鉴权、反爬策略及服务协议合规性设计。

items.title: N1nEmAn/sapper-v2
items.summary: The first fruit of the Nüwa tree — an autonomous AI pentest legion (634-team champion, 8h unattended, 1B tokens beat 4.5B). Not just a tool: evolvable by design. Grow your own fruit on the Nüwa Foundation (Create/Language/History).
items.summary_zh: N1nEmAn 开源 sapper-v2，这是一个具备自我演进能力的自动化渗透测试 Agent 框架，通过 Nüwa Foundation 实现任务规划与历史记忆管理。
items.why_zh: Agent 自主学习与演进架构。可学习如何构建具备长短期记忆与任务规划能力的 Agent 闭环，以及在对抗性任务中的自动化决策机制。

items.title: Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs
items.summary: Google released TPU Sync, an open-source C++ library that moves KV caches and weights across TPU HBM, host DRAM, storage and network. Google reports over 90% lower KV transfer latency on 235B to 480B MoE models. The post Google Releases TPU Sync: Open-Source KV Cache Transfer for TPUs appeared first on MarkTechPost .
items.summary_zh: Google 开源 TPU Sync C++ 库，支持在 TPU HBM、主机 DRAM 及网络间高效传输 KV Cache 与权重，显著降低 MoE 模型推理延迟。
items.why_zh: 大模型推理性能优化。掌握分布式推理中 KV Cache 的内存管理与跨节点传输技术，是优化超大规模模型部署的关键工程能力。

items.title: How Mozilla uses GPT-6 Cyber to find and fix Firefox vulnerabilities
items.summary: Mozilla is combining decades of security engineering with AI agents to strengthen Firefox’s defenses. Brian Grinstead joins OpenAI’s Clint Gibler to discuss how the team prioritizes investigations, tests and verifies vulnerabilities, finds related bug patterns, and helps engineers develop fixes. They also explore how GPT-6 Cyber revealed that some known bugs could be more serious than initially understood, helping inform which issues need attention first. Across its security workflow, Mozilla sa…
items.summary_zh: Mozilla 结合 GPT-6 Cyber 安全模型，通过 AI Agent 自动化执行漏洞优先级排序、模式识别及修复方案生成，强化 Firefox 安全防御。
items.why_zh: AI 辅助软件工程。可借鉴 Agent 在代码审计与漏洞修复中的工作流设计，特别是如何将领域专家知识与 LLM 推理能力结合。

items.title: I Trust My AI Agents to Merge Code… But NOT Ship It
items.summary: I trust my agents to merge code all night, but I definitely don't trust them to ship straight to production. Tests and reviews only tell you the code looks right. LaunchDarkly helps teams control and monitor how changes behave once they're live in production. They just launched Release Autopilot, where agents do the feature flag work that used to take an engineer: risk classification, success metrics, automatic release plans that start with a canary release, feature-level observability and flag …
items.summary_zh: LaunchDarkly 发布 Release Autopilot，利用 AI Agent 自动化处理特征标志管理、风险分类及成功指标监控，实现生产环境的受控发布。
items.why_zh: AI Agent 的生产环境治理。学习如何通过特征标志（Feature Flags）构建 Agent 的安全护栏，实现自动化发布流程的风险隔离与可观测性。

items.summary_zh: Google 发布 Gemini 4 系列模型及 Swarm 多智能体框架，支持多模型协同工作，并展示了 Gemini 4 Carbon 在复杂视频编辑任务中的自主执行能力。
items.why_zh: 多智能体协同架构。关注 Swarm 框架下的任务拆解与多模型调度机制，理解如何通过多 Agent 协作处理长链路、多步骤的复杂任务。

items.title: A New Dawn in the Cloud: ‘Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV’ Is Coming to GeForce NOW

There’s more on the horizon, with NVIDIA DLSS 5 technology coming to War Thunder and Where Winds Meet. Meanwhile, Dragon’s Dogma 2: Dark Arisen brings new tales […]
items.summary_zh: NVIDIA 宣布 GeForce NOW 云游戏平台引入 Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV，并为 War Thunder 等游戏集成 DLSS 5 技术。

items.title: 中金公司与蚂蚁集团达成战略合作 共探AI赋能财富管理
